source_summary: Tall hanging-scroll Chinese landscape with ink-and-light-color mountains above a lake, mist bands, reed-filled water, pavilions, boats, scholar figures, and dense foreground trees/rocks. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: central_layered_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the large upper-center mountain mass with rounded layered slopes, darker rocky right flank, clustered shrubs, and the small exposed rock-and-tree hollow near the lower middle of the mountain. Exclude surrounding calligraphy and seals.
must_preserve: fine contour linework following the rounded ridges
soft grey ink wash gradations on the slopes
dark dry-brush texture on the right cliff face
clustered rock forms in the central hollow
small scrub trees and leaf dots along the crest and ravines
mist-softened lower mountain edges

motifs.name: left_distant_peak_and_mist
motifs.description: Isolate the small distant peak at upper left with its pale sloping sides, dark crest vegetation, adjacent low ridge, and surrounding horizontal mist/water wash. Exclude nearby red seals.
must_preserve: thin pale ridge outlines
dark stippled foliage on the peak top
faint horizontal mist strokes at the base
soft washed transition into water
subtle layered ridge behind the peak

motifs.name: right_pavilion_hillside
motifs.description: Isolate the small pavilion group on the right hillside, including tiered roof geometry, terrace lines, surrounding bamboo or slender trees, and the sloping bank beneath it. Do not include seals or unrelated calligraphy above.
must_preserve: precise roof eaves and stacked pavilion outlines
thin architectural linework of platforms and railings
bamboo-like vertical stems and fine leaves at the right
light hillside contour lines
misty pale background separating buildings from lake
small dark shrub accents around the terrace

motifs.name: broad_lake_with_reeds
motifs.description: Isolate the middle-left expanse of lake surface with fine ripple lines, pale water wash, scattered reed beds, and low marsh grasses. Exclude large foreground tree trunks and boats.
must_preserve: closely spaced horizontal ripple strokes
faint tonal wash variations across the water
clusters of thin reed blades and marsh grasses
soft blank-water areas suggesting mist
small dark floating marks on the lake
delicate shoreline transitions

motifs.name: central_reed_island_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the central small island or bank with mixed shrubs, bare saplings, reeds, and light ground contours rising from the water.
must_preserve: thin bare tree branches with angular joints
leaf-dot clusters on the bushy shrubs
fine reed and grass strokes at the waterline
pale mound contour lines
subtle ink wash beneath the vegetation
overlapping branch structure without merging into nearby hills

motifs.name: right_cottage_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-right riverside cottage and surrounding grove, including the thatched roof, seated figure inside, tall trunks, flowering or dotted foliage, fence marks, and sloped bank.
must_preserve: thatched roof texture and simple wall posts
tiny seated scholar figure inside the cottage
tall dark tree trunks with root bases
fine branch tracery and dotted blossoms or leaves
fence and garden line details
dry-brush shadows on the hillside bank
nearby reeds and grasses at the water edge

motifs.name: scholar_boat_under_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the small boat carrying a scholar beneath the overhanging trees, including the low canopy or cabin, seated figure, boat hull, nearby bamboo, and surrounding narrow water channel. Exclude the large foreground rock mass where possible.
must_preserve: slender boat hull outline
small seated scholar figure and robe lines
low arched boat cover or canopy texture
nearby bamboo leaves and thin stems
fine ripple lines around the boat
delicate bank grasses framing the channel

motifs.name: foreground_gnarled_pines_rock_promontory
motifs.description: Isolate the large lower-left foreground promontory with twisted pine trunks, exposed roots, needle clusters, dense shrubs, and heavily textured rocks descending toward the water. Do not include the nearby boat as part of the motif.
must_preserve: gnarled twisting pine trunk contours
tufts of pine needles at branch tips
exposed roots gripping the rocks
dark shrub masses at the base
layered rock outlines with dry-brush creases
grey-brown wash accents on trunks and stones
small grasses and reeds along the shoreline

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
